summary: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a History tab, displays user messages as a clickable directory, and lets users jump directly to selected messages in the Chat view.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is best classified as a Navigation & Panels tool because its primary user-facing function is a session History tab in DeepSeek Harness that renders a clickable directory of user messages and jumps to selected messages. The README describes auto-filtering to user-only entries, automatic older-history paging, and in-chat jump behavior; package metadata shows a web client DSH bundle with `client`/`ui-conversation` integration, confirming a UI navigation purpose rather than code-generation, data export, or external service integration.
